literal: Daozong, Part One
idiomatic: Daozong, Part One

literal: Emperor Xiaowen of Daozong, taboo name Hongji, courtesy name Nielin, childhood name Zala.
idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowen of Daozong, taboo name Hongji, courtesy name Nielin, childhood name Zala.

literal: He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Rende of the Xiao clan.
idiomatic: He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Rende of the Xiao clan.

literal: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.
idiomatic: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.

literal: In the eleventh year of Chongxi, he was advanced to Prince of Yan and oversaw Central Secretariat affairs.
idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chongxi he was advanced to Prince of Yan and oversaw Central Secretariat affairs.

literal: The next year he oversaw Southern and Northern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.
idiomatic: The next year he oversaw Southern and Northern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.

literal: In the twenty-first year he became grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven, administrator of tiyin affairs, and participated in court government.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he became grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven, administrator of tiyin affairs, and participated in court government.

literal: The Emperor's nature was calm and stern; at each audience Xingzong would compose himself on his account.
idiomatic: The Emperor's nature was calm and stern; at each audience Xingzong would compose himself on his account.

literal: In the twenty-fourth year, autumn, eighth month, on a ji day, Xingzong died; he took the throne before the bier and, in deep grief, would not govern.
idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, in the eighth autumn month on a ji day, Xingzong died; he took the throne before the bier and, in deep grief, would not govern.

literal: On xinmao day the hundred officials memorialized repeatedly urging him; he assented.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the hundred officials memorialized repeatedly urging him, and he assented.

literal: Edict said: "I, with slight virtue, have been placed above the people, and I only fear my wisdom and knowledge may fall short and that those below may not trust me;
idiomatic: An edict said: "I, with slight virtue, have been placed above the people, and I only fear my wisdom and knowledge may fall short and that those below may not trust me;

literal: taxes and levies may be rashly raised, rewards and punishments may miss the mark;
idiomatic: taxes and levies may be rashly raised, rewards and punishments may miss the mark;

literal: the sovereign's grace may not reach those below, and sentiment below may not reach the sovereign.
idiomatic: the sovereign's grace may not reach those below, and sentiment below may not reach the sovereign.

literal: All you scholars and commoners, speak frankly without reserve.
idiomatic: Let all scholars and commoners speak frankly without reserve.

literal: What is fit, select and use; what is not, do not treat it as fault.
idiomatic: What is fit, select and use; what is not, do not treat it as fault.

literal: You ministers, embody my intent.
idiomatic: You ministers, embody my intent."

literal: On renchen day the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.
idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.

literal: On guisi day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and to Xia and Goryeo.
idiomatic: On guisi day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and to Xia and Goryeo.

literal: On jiawu day Chongyuan was dispatched to reassure troops and people at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Chongyuan was dispatched to reassure troops and people at Nanjing.

literal: On wuxu day, by the testamentary edict, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was made Northern Court chancellor and still acted as Southern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court chancellor Xiao Xulie was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
idiomatic: On wuxu day, by the testamentary edict, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was made Northern Court chancellor and still acted as Southern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court chancellor Xiao Xulie was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

literal: On xinchou day the era name was changed to Qingning and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the era name was changed to Qingning and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Ninth month, on wuwu day, edict ordered that outside hunting grounds the Emperor often favored, there was to be no prohibition.
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the ninth month an edict ordered that outside hunting grounds the Emperor often favored, there was to be no prohibition.

literal: On gengshen day, edict removed guard soldiers; the rest might not wear blades when entering the palace;
idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict removed guard soldiers; the rest might not wear blades when entering the palace;

literal: except meritorious kin, descendants, yilijin, deputy commissioners, and attendants of various posts, none might wear the official headcloth.
idiomatic: except meritorious kin, descendants, yilijin, deputy commissioners, and attendants of various posts, none might wear the official headcloth.

literal: On renxu day, edict ordered that yilijin and deputy commissioners' clans together with commoner slaves and the base might not wear tuoni or otter-fur coats; knife handles, hawk-bells, saddles, straps, and pendants might not use rhinoceros horn, jade, or bone-tipped rhinoceros horn;
idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered that yilijin and deputy commissioners' clans together with commoner slaves and the base might not wear tuoni or otter-fur coats; knife handles, hawk-bells, saddles, straps, and pendants might not use rhinoceros horn, jade, or bone-tipped rhinoceros horn;

literal: only great generals were not forbidden.
idiomatic: only great generals were not forbidden.

literal: On yichou day rank and rewards were granted to inner and outer officials by degree.
idiomatic: On yichou day rank and rewards were granted to inner and outer officials by degree.

literal: On gengwu day the Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

literal: On xinwei day Left yilibi Xiao Molu and Hanlin academician Han Yun were dispatched to present the late emperor's bequeathed goods to Song.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Left yilibi Xiao Molu and Hanlin academician Han Yun were dispatched to present the late emperor's bequeathed goods to Song.

literal: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to inform Song of the accession.
idiomatic: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to inform Song of the accession.

literal: On bingzi day the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager and a banquet was held at Zatu Hall.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager and a banquet was held at Zatu Hall.

literal: Supreme Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu was made regent of Nanjing.
idiomatic: Supreme Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu was made regent of Nanjing.

literal: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to bestow the late emperor's bequeathed goods on Goryeo and Xia State.
idiomatic: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to bestow the late emperor's bequeathed goods on Goryeo and Xia State.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dinghai day, the relevant offices requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Heavenly Peace Festival; assented.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the tenth winter month the relevant offices requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Heavenly Peace Festival; the request was granted.

literal: Prince of Wu Renxian was made associate regent of Nanjing; Prince of Chen Tubote was made Southern Court chancellor and advanced to Prince of Wu.
idiomatic: Prince of Wu Renxian was made associate regent of Nanjing; Prince of Chen Tubote was made Southern Court chancellor and advanced to Prince of Wu.

literal: On renyin day Shunyi Army military commissioner Shishennu was made Southern Court great king.
idiomatic: On renyin day Shunyi Army military commissioner Shishennu was made Southern Court great king.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiazi day, Emperor Xingzong was buried at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the eleventh month Emperor Xingzong was buried at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Song and Goryeo dispatched envoys to attend.
idiomatic: Song and Goryeo sent envoys to attend.

literal: The mountain was named Yongxing.
idiomatic: The mountain was named Yongxing.

literal: On bingyin day Southern Court great king Hougu was made regent of the Central Capital; Northern Court chancellor Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was advanced to Prince of Han.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Southern Court great king Hougu was made regent of the Central Capital; Northern Court chancellor Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was advanced to Prince of Han.

literal: On renshen day halted at Huai Prefecture.
idiomatic: On renshen day the court halted at Huai Prefecture.

literal: Rites were performed at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.
idiomatic: Rites were performed at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.

literal: On jiaxu day paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

literal: On wuyin day, winter solstice, rites were performed at Taizu's, Jingzong's, and Xingzong's temples; the court did not receive congratulations from the ministers.
idiomatic: On wuyin day, the winter solstice, rites were performed at Taizu's, Jingzong's, and Xingzong's temples; the court did not receive congratulations from the ministers.

literal: Twelfth month, on bingxu day, edict to the Left yilibi said: "I, young and small, have received the great position; day and night I worry and fear lest I be unequal to it.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the twelfth month an edict to the Left yilibi said: "I, young and small, have received the great position; day and night I worry and fear lest I be unequal to it.

literal: I wish to hear frank speech to correct my faults.
idiomatic: I wish to hear frank speech to correct my faults.

literal: Now several months have passed, yet I have not seen what fulfills my intent to entrust you as arms and legs and ears and eyes.
idiomatic: Now several months have passed, yet I have not seen what fulfills my intent to entrust you as arms and legs and ears and eyes.

literal: Order inner and outer officials of all ranks, when their term is complete, each to speak on one matter.
idiomatic: Order inner and outer officials of all ranks, when their term is complete, each to speak on one matter.

literal: Also relay instructions to their jurisdictions: without regard to noble or base, old or young, all may speak frankly without reserve.
idiomatic: Also relay instructions to their jurisdictions: without regard to noble or base, old or young, all may speak frankly without reserve."

literal: On wuzi day, the Responding Sage Festival, longevity was wished for the Grand Empress Dowager; ministers and titled wives were feasted; consort Xiao was invested Empress.
idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Responding Sage Festival, longevity was wished for the Grand Empress Dowager; ministers and titled wives were feasted; consort Xiao was invested Empress.

literal: The Emperor's younger brother Prince of Yue Heluwo was advanced to Prince of Lu; Prince of Xu Alian to Prince of Chen; Prince of Chu Nielugu was transferred to Prince of Wu.
idiomatic: The Emperor's younger brother Prince of Yue Heluwo was advanced to Prince of Lu; Prince of Xu Alian to Prince of Chen; Prince of Chu Nielugu was transferred to Prince of Wu.

literal: On xinmao day edict to the Deployment Office: when affairs were confidential they were to be memorialized at once; whoever submitted or received libelous writings was to be executed in the market along with the reader.
idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict to the Deployment Office ordered that when affairs were confidential they were to be memorialized at once; whoever submitted or received libelous writings was to be executed in the market along with the reader.

literal: On guisi day ten princes of the imperial clan were disrespectful to their mother and were executed.
idiomatic: On guisi day ten princes of the imperial clan were disrespectful to their mother and were executed.

literal: On jiawu day associate privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Hanlin academician Wu Zhan associate privy commissioner; Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner Han Shaowen supreme capital regent.
idiomatic: On jiawu day associate privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Hanlin academician Wu Zhan associate privy commissioner; Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner Han Shaowen supreme capital regent.

literal: On bingshen day Song dispatched Ouyang Xiu and others to congratulate the accession.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Song sent Ouyang Xiu and others to congratulate the accession.

literal: On wuxu day edict ordered schools established to nurture scholars, the commentaries on the Five Classics promulgated, and one doctor and one assistant instructor appointed each.
idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict ordered schools established to nurture scholars, the commentaries on the Five Classics promulgated, and one doctor and one assistant instructor appointed each.

literal: On guimao day Zhuo Prefecture administrator Yang Ji was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On guimao day Zhuo Prefecture administrator Yang Ji was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner.

literal: On gengxu day, because it was Shengzong's birthday while he lived, prisoners at the Supreme Capital were pardoned.
idiomatic: On gengxu day, because it was Shengzong's birthday while he lived, prisoners at the Supreme Capital were pardoned.

literal: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.
idiomatic: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on bingchen day, edict ordered prefectural and district officials and subordinates to decide criminal cases like the various tribal precedents.
idiomatic: In the second year, on bingchen day of the first spring month an edict ordered prefectural and district officials and subordinates to decide criminal cases like the various tribal precedents.

literal: On jisi day, edict ordered that the Ernügu tribe, when hereditary in selection for chancellor and military commissioner, be exempted from the Pishi Army.
idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered that the Ernügu tribe, when hereditary in selection for chancellor and military commissioner, be exempted from the Pishi Army.

literal: That month, visited Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: That month the court visited Yuer Marsh.

literal: Second month, on yiyou day, made Left yilibi Xiao Molu Southwest Route pacification inspector-general.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the second month Left yilibi Xiao Molu was made Southwest Route pacification inspector-general.

literal: On yisi day, because it was Xingzong's birthday while he lived, ministers were feasted and each ordered to compose a poem.
idiomatic: On yisi day, because it was Xingzong's birthday while he lived, ministers were feasted and each ordered to compose a poem.

literal: Third month, on dingsi day, the Responding Sage Festival; partial amnesty for prisoners within a hundred li.
idiomatic: On dingsi day of the third month, the Responding Sage Festival, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners within a hundred li.

literal: On jimao day the Emperor's composition 《Rhapsody on Releasing the Hawk》 was bestowed on the ministers, instructing them in employing ministers.
idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor's composition 《Rhapsody on Releasing the Hawk》 was bestowed on the ministers, instructing them in employing ministers.

literal: Intercalary month, on jihai day, Eastern Capital coinage was first put in circulation.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jihai day, Eastern Capital coinage was first put in circulation.

literal: On yisi day Nanjing's prisons were empty; the regent and officials below were promoted.
idiomatic: On yisi day Nanjing's prisons were empty; the regent and officials below were promoted.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiazi day, edict said: "In midsummer, the season when birds and beasts breed and grow, fire must not be set loose in the suburbs.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fourth summer month an edict said: "In midsummer, the season when birds and beasts breed and grow, fire must not be set loose in the suburbs."

literal: May, on wuxu day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the fifth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On jiachen day rites were performed at Xingzong's temple.
idiomatic: On jiachen day rites were performed at Xingzong's temple.

literal: Sixth month, on dingsi day, edict ordered chancellors to recommend men of talent; on wuwu day ordered the relevant offices to register troops to replenish border garrisons.
idiomatic: On dingsi day of the sixth month an edict ordered chancellors to recommend men of talent; on wuwu day the relevant offices were ordered to register troops to replenish border garrisons.

literal: On xinyou day Zubu chieftains came to court and presented local products.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Zubu chieftains came to court and presented local products.

literal: On dingmao day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On xinwei day abolished historians' participation in hearing court deliberations; they were to inquire of the chancellor before writing.
idiomatic: On xinwei day historians' participation in hearing court deliberations was abolished; they were to inquire of the chancellor before writing.

literal: On yihai day locusts and larvae caused disaster at the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On yihai day locusts and larvae caused disaster at the Central Capital.

literal: On bingzi day, edict ordered that when banditry was substantiated, all routes might decide the case.
idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict ordered that when banditry was substantiated, all routes might decide the case.

literal: On dingchou day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zhao Chage was made supreme capital regent; associate regent of Nanjing Prince of Wu Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zhao Chage was made supreme capital regent; associate regent of Nanjing Prince of Wu Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

literal: On yiyou day envoys were dispatched on separate routes to equalize taxes and levies, repair weapons, encourage farming and sericulture, and forbid bandits.
idiomatic: On yiyou day envoys were dispatched on separate routes to equalize taxes and levies, repair weapons, encourage farming and sericulture, and forbid bandits.

literal: Eighth month, on xinwei day, went to autumn mountains.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the eighth month the court went to autumn mountains.

literal: Ninth month, on gengzi day, visited the Central Capital and sacrificed to Shengzong and Xingzong at Hui'an Hall.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the ninth month the court visited the Central Capital and sacrificed to Shengzong and Xingzong at Hui'an Hall.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingzi day, went to Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the tenth winter month the court went to Zhonghuichuan.

literal: Eleventh month, on wuxu day, Yelü Huali, who administered Left yilibi affairs, was made yilibi; Northern Court great king Yelü Xiantong was made administrator of Huanglong Prefecture.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the eleventh month Yelü Huali, who administered Left yilibi affairs, was made yilibi; Northern Court great king Yelü Xiantong was made administrator of Huanglong Prefecture.

literal: On jiachen day civil and military officials presented the honorific title Heavenly Blessing Emperor; the Empress, Virtuous and Gracious Empress.
idiomatic: On jiachen day civil and military officials presented the honorific title Heavenly Blessing Emperor; the Empress, Virtuous and Gracious Empress.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On yisi day the imperial uncle Chongyuan was made grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven; Prince of Zhao Chage was transferred to Prince of Wei, Prince of Lu Heluwo to Prince of Song, Prince of Chen Alian to Prince of Qin, Prince of Wu Nielugu advanced to Prince of Chu; officials were promoted and transferred by degree.
idiomatic: On yisi day the imperial uncle Chongyuan was made grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven; Prince of Zhao Chage was transferred to Prince of Wei, Prince of Lu Heluwo to Prince of Song, Prince of Chen Alian to Prince of Qin, Prince of Wu Nielugu advanced to Prince of Chu; officials were promoted and transferred by degree.

literal: Twelfth month, on wushen new moon, Prince of Han Xiao Ala was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu Northern Court chancellor; Prince of Song Heluwo supreme capital regent; Prince of Qin Alian administrator of Central Secretariat affairs.
idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the twelfth month Prince of Han Xiao Ala was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu Northern Court chancellor; Prince of Song Heluwo supreme capital regent; Prince of Qin Alian administrator of Central Secretariat affairs.

literal: On jiayin day the Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Gracious, Benevolent, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Filial, Broadly Reverent, Loving, Honored, Heavenly Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Gracious, Benevolent, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Filial, Broadly Reverent, Loving, Honored, Heavenly Empress Dowager.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on gengchen day, went to the Duck River.
idiomatic: In the third year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

literal: On bingxu day the Daotaoling military commissioner was established.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the Daotaoling military commissioner was established.

literal: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States presented local products.
idiomatic: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States presented local products.

literal: Second month, on jiwei day, went to Dayu Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the second month the court went to Dayu Marsh.

literal: Third month, on xinsi day, Prince of Chu Nielugu was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the third month Prince of Chu Nielugu was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingchen day, summered at Yongan Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingchen day of the fourth summer month the court summered at Yongan Mountain.

literal: Fifth month, on jihai day, visited Qing Mausoleum and offered libation at the Golden Hall and Tongtian Hall.
idiomatic: On jihai day of the fifth month the court visited Qing Mausoleum and offered libation at the Golden Hall and Tongtian Hall.

literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day, Prince of Wei Chage was made tiyin; associate privy commissioner Xiao Tanggu Southern Court chancellor; Prince of Wei Tiebu Eastern Capital regent.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the sixth month Prince of Wei Chage was made tiyin; associate privy commissioner Xiao Tanggu Southern Court chancellor; Prince of Wei Tiebu Eastern Capital regent.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiashen day Nanjing had an earthquake; amnesty within its territory.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the seventh autumn month Nanjing had an earthquake; amnesty was granted within its territory.

literal: On yiyou day went to autumn mountains.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the court went to autumn mountains.

literal: Eighth month, on xinhai day, the Emperor presented the Grand Empress Dowager with 《Collected Poems on Ruler and Minister Sharing One Will and Chinese and Barbarian Sharing One Custom》.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the eighth month the Emperor presented the Grand Empress Dowager with 《Collected Poems on Ruler and Minister Sharing One Will and Chinese and Barbarian Sharing One Custom》.

literal: Ninth month, on gengzi day, visited Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the ninth month the court visited Zhonghuichuan.
